objective: Prove: (1) in a law that composes like cycles every reflexive pp-definable relation on a range is total or lies below its top; (2) the top lemma: a set of variables is free exactly when its image in the product of the tops is full, by parallel copies; (3) the top image of every tie is the graph of a bijection between the tops; (4) at each variable of a knot the top image is functional or every two top values share a fibre; (5) Conjecture 6 of MALTSEV-CONDITIONS-20261021-001B-P001 is false (parity beside J; K4 beside the Z3 law); (6) in disjoint unions every knot lies in one part, so being Mal'tsev on the tops of knot ranges survives disjoint unions; state the repaired conjecture and what it would give.
status: Proved by CYCLE-TOPS-20261021-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof with randomized and exhaustive checks; parallel exchange in matroids cited as textbook). In every law that composes like cycles, every reflexive pp-definable relation on a range is total or lies inside its top, and every system has exactly the circuits of its image modulo the tops: each variable and its blurred copy are parallel in one system, so circuits pass to the copies. This proves the top-lemma form of MATROID-CONVERSE-20261021-001B-P001 Conjecture 5 without any difference operation. Tie top images are bijections, and at each variable of a knot the top image is functional or every two top classes share a fibre. Conjecture 6 of MALTSEV-CONDITIONS-20261021-001B-P001 is false: parity beside J (MALTSEV-CONVERSE-20261020-001B-P001, Proposition 1) and K4 beside the Z3 law compose like cycles, but their whole-domain top is equality and no operation is Mal'tsev there. Restricted to knot ranges the condition passes to disjoint unions, and census A found it in every surviving law. Open: Conjecture 7 for all laws, and whether a knot's top image can overlap.
title: Proof: composing like cycles is decided on the tops
